cases.name: Joy Marie Matthews
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Joy was a very outgoing person who had many friends.  She liked to be around her family and when she was able to, she enjoyed traveling, being in the outdoors, camping, going to the casino, ricing, going to concerts, and going to pow-wows with her grandchildren.  Joy’s love and passion was spending time with her grandkids.  She will be sadly missed by all her family and many friends."
